summary: Butterfield filed a Form 6-K furnishing CIBC Caribbean’s audited and interim carve-out financial statements, following its May 27, 2026 share purchase agreement to acquire CIBC’s interest in CIBC Caribbean from CIBC and CIBC Investments (Cayman). The filing provides historical financials for the target, with Ernst & Young as auditor. No deal price, premium, or close date is stated. This is a regulatory disclosure supporting the acquisition; watch for merger approval timelines and integration progress.
